paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved -0.37% on average, with Hang Seng strongest (+0.69%) and Dow Jones weakest (-1.23%). Brent crude changed +3.14% to 116.72. Gold changed -1.29% to 4,007.8999. Bitcoin changed -0.67% to 80,533.3203. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.988%, a relative move of +0.71%. Among the firms tracked, Equinor (+5.17%) and Newmont (-4.59%) moved the most.
